newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING-APT Satellite Holdings Limited.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING-APT Satellite Holdings Limited.

text.p: Company Name APT Satellite Holdings Limited
Total ordinary shares to be offered 105.0 million
U.S. shrs offered by company 52.5 million
International shrs offered by company 42.0 million Hong Kong shrs offered by company 10.5 million
Shrs outstanding after global ipo 420.0 million
Lead Global Underwriter Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette

Underwriters ordinary share over-allotment 15,750,000 shares * Note: estimated price represents offering in American Depositary Shares. Each ADS will represent eight ordinary shrs. Business: The Hong Kong company is a provider of high quality satellite services throughout China and Asia-Pacific region. Use of Proceeds: Estimated US$222.8 million will go mainly to repay certain indebtedness of APT and partially finance build and launch of APSTAR IIR and future satellite projects. Financial Data in 000s: N/A
